verdict.rationale: Composio's docs name a COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH meta-tool that runs Python in a remote sandbox 'for bulk operations or processing large tool responses,' and say its meta-tools can execute tools across apps in parallel. So bulk work is possible, but it runs through agent-written sandbox code and parallel calls rather than documented native batch endpoints. Missing for 10: documented native batch/bulk tool APIs, details on limits and scale for bulk runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations working in practice.
